description: A file "License" next to "LICENSE" in the library folder, listed in the manifest. The names differ only in case (PKG-07); "License" is also not a file the library folder may hold (STR-01), which cannot be avoided: every second name in a folder is a file the format does not have.

app.note: An app that stops at the first refusing rule reports PKG-07, which its ZIP reader finds first.
